findings.desc: multi-turn-fidelity: real-loop-agent.mjs:42 sets output=out.slice(0,400) where `out` is the raw JSON envelope from claude -p --output-format json (e.g. {"subtype":"success","result":"<agent text>","total_cost_usd":...}). The harness feeds r.output back as next-turn context on live-loop-harness.mjs:138. So the real multi-turn --run path injects the JSON wrapper metadata as context instead of j.result (the agent actual response text). Fix: parse j.result from the already-parsed object and expose it as output, e.g. `output: p.result ?? p.rawResult ?? out.slice(0,400)` — requires parseClaudeResult to also return the result field, or inline the JSON.parse here.
